notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Treasures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Vihaan triggers, causing all Treasures you control to become 3/3 Construct Assassins in addition to their other types.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
When the Treasures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers seven times, creating seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger ability, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
